kyoto_shokushu_dokoro_tsukushi.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: miso-simmered mackerel and soy-based obanzai (2022–2026 reviews).
kyoto_shokushu_dokoro_tsukushi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: marinated mackerel, funazushi and Lake Biwa fish, dashi obanzai (2022–2026 reviews).
kyoto_shokushu_dokoro_tsukushi.hours_raw: Tabelog: Mon, Thu–Sun 17:00–22:00; closed Tuesday and Wednesday. Reservations taken; walk-ins seated when there is room (July 2025). Counter and tables full of regulars. Cash only: no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). Down a back alley east of Kawaramachi at Takoyakushi; you cannot see inside from the street (March 2025).
kyoto_shokushu_dokoro_tsukushi.notes: [Obanzai bar · Kawaramachi-Takoyakushi alley, a family counter for regulars] A Showa-era family obanzai bar down an alley off Kawaramachi, run by a couple with the founder still at the counter: plates of three or four obanzai, yuba, cured mackerel, a Lake Biwa set of funazushi and moroko, and local sake, among chatty regulars who welcome newcomers. Cash only. Closed Tuesday and Wednesday.

roles: A husband-and-wife team with the elderly founder (January 2025 review); not named
chef_bio.background: Reviewers from 2020 to 2026 describe a warm, Showa-era room full of regulars: in 2020 the owner was cooking alone; a September 2022 diner met the retired 85-year-old former owner; and a January 2025 diner found the husband-and-wife owners running it with the 91-year-old founder. A July 2025 visitor came after seeing it on a TV drinking programme.

anecdotes.text: January 2025: "The husband and wife owners, along with the 91-year-old head chef, run the place together… The healthy obanzai (small side dishes) came as 4 rather than the expected 3."
September 2022: "The atmosphere of the restaurant is a perfect example of how customers create the vibe. While there are many regulars, newcomers are warmly welcomed as well."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 食酒処土筆、日本料理、中京区蛸薬師河原町東、京都河原町駅から307m、月木金土日 17:00〜22:00、火・水休み、予約可、カード・電子マネー・QR不可。口コミ (2020年11月〜2026年8月、英語): 河原町の裏路地の昭和の家庭的なおばんざいの店、常連が多いが初めてでも歓迎、夫婦と91歳の先代 (2025年1月)、85歳の引退した先代 (2022年9月)、2020年は女将がひとりで料理、本日のおばんざい3〜4品、湯葉、ポテトサラダ、しめ鯖、だし巻、銀杏、鯖の味噌煮、ごぼうの酢の物、もろこ・鮒寿司・えび豆の琵琶湖セット、サッポロラガー赤星、玉乃光、Kikko、Daiseikyo などの日本酒、テレビの酒場番組で紹介。

existence.note: Tabelog listing with reviews dated through August 2026.

kyoto_uru_coffee_teramachi.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: open sandwiches and cheesecake (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_uru_coffee_teramachi.vegan_detail: Ask: black coffee is plant-based; lattes, cheesecake and sandwiches are not described for plant milk (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_uru_coffee_teramachi.hours_raw: Tabelog: daily 10:00–20:00. No reservations. 6 seats plus stair seating, ground floor only; open-fronted with no door, so chilly at night (March 2026); no restroom (January 2026). Dogs welcome on a lead, water provided (May 2026). English menu; take-away; wheelchair accessible. No service charge — Tabelog, Japanese original 「なし」. Cards (JCB), e-money, QR. On Teramachi-Kyogoku arcade, opposite Niko and… Opened 10 December 2025 (Tabelog).
kyoto_uru_coffee_teramachi.notes: [Coffee stand · Teramachi-Kyogoku, a vintage shop's café] A stylish, open-fronted café on the Teramachi arcade, opened December 2025 by the vintage clothing shop HYPE: light-roast coffee from Osaka roaster ue., open sandwiches and a salted cheesecake, with dogs welcome. Only six seats and no restroom; some found it pricey and cramped (March 2026) or the Americano too acidic (July 2026).

roles: Not named in a source; run by the vintage clothing shop HYPE (December 2025 reviews)
chef_bio.background: Opened 10 December 2025 (Tabelog). December 2025 reviewers call it the café of the vintage clothing store HYPE, using beans from the Osaka specialty roaster ue.; others describe crimson tiles, an orange interior, a bonsai, a speaker blending arcade sounds and music, and a kind owner who brews well (March 2026).

anecdotes.text: March 2026: "the space inside is a bit cramped, and the prices are somewhat on the higher side."
May 2026: "I was pleasantly surprised to learn that I could let my dog down while keeping it on a leash inside. They even provided water for my dog."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: uru coffee、カフェ、中京区東側町501-10、阪急河原町駅から徒歩5分、毎日 10:00〜20:00、予約不可、6席、テラス、禁煙、英語メニュー、持ち帰り、車椅子可、原文でサービス料「なし」、カード (JCB)・電子マネー・QR可、2025年12月10日オープン。口コミ (2025年12月〜2026年8月、英語): 寺町京極商店街、古着屋HYPEのカフェ、大阪・新町のスペシャルティコーヒー店 ue. の浅煎り豆、カフェラテ700円、カプチーノ、アイスアメリカーノ、オープンサンドのハーフ&ハーフ1,400円、アボカドサンド1,300円、自家製チーズケーキ700〜800円、抹茶テリーヌ、ジンジャーエール500円、階段も席に、扉がなく夜は寒い、トイレなし、犬連れ可、狭く値段が高めという声、アメリカーノが酸っぱいという声。

existence.note: Tabelog listing (opened December 2025) with reviews through August 2026.

kyoto_taishu_sakaba_heiwa.gf_detail: Not GF: sauced and marinated meats, mentaiko karaage, garlic bean-sprout namul; strong seasonings throughout (2026 reviews).
kyoto_taishu_sakaba_heiwa.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a meat tavern — tongue, horumon, wagyu, pig's feet (2026 reviews).
kyoto_taishu_sakaba_heiwa.hours_raw: Daily 17:00–24:00; last orders food 23:30, drinks 23:45 (Tabelog). Reservations accepted and advised — full at 21:00 on a Saturday (Tabelog; September 2026). Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). 34 seats: 5 at the counter, 29 at tables, packed close together (Tabelog; August 2026). Smoking allowed (Tabelog; July–September 2026). No draft beer — bottled Sapporo Lager Akaboshi instead (July 2026). Off Takoyakushi east of Kawaramachi; 3 min walk from Kawaramachi Stn (Tabelog). Opened 1 July 2026 (Tabelog).
kyoto_taishu_sakaba_heiwa.notes: [Meat tavern · Kawaramachi-Takoyakushi] A lively new Showa-retro meat tavern run by a former sumo wrestler, per reviewers: green benches, sumo and wrestling posters, ¥299 bottles of Sapporo Akaboshi, and fresh heart and omasum sashimi, thick tongue and A5 wagyu, grilled for you. Seasonings are strong and tables tight; smoking is allowed. Book at weekends; till midnight.

roles: Owner (unnamed; a former sumo wrestler, per reviews)
chef_bio.background: Per reviews (July–September 2026): a meat tavern opened in July 2026 by an owner described as a former sumo wrestler; a July 2026 reviewer writes that the owner went independent from the Tenmaya Group and chose a "meat tavern" over a yakiniku restaurant. Tabelog gives the opening date as 1 July 2026.
chef_bio.philosophy: A meat tavern rather than a yakiniku restaurant (July 2026 review).

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 diner who doubted a ¥9,999 black wagyu tomahawk could pay took a photo with the owner, who joked, "I feel like a sumo wrestler too!".
A July 2026 reviewer was surprised to find the mentaiko karaage looked like chicken-wing gyoza.
An August 2026 pair found many dishes seasoned alike and the tables close together — lively, but a lot for those who like quiet.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 居酒屋・焼肉・肉料理、中京区蛸薬師通河原町東入備前島町309-6、京都河原町駅から徒歩3分、毎日 17:00〜24:00 (L.O.フード23:30、ドリンク23:45)、予約可、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、34席 (カウンター5、テーブル29)、喫煙可、2026年7月1日開店。口コミ (2026年7月〜9月、英語): 元力士の店主、Tenmaya Group から独立との声、昭和レトロ、緑のベンチ、プロレスや相撲のグッズ、生ビールなし、サッポロラガー赤星の瓶299円、ハツ刺し、センマイ、ユッケ、冷凍しない厚切りタン (特上・上・並)、A5和牛のロースを3枚から、黒毛和牛のトマホーク9,999円、焼いて出すか自分で焼く、明太子唐揚げ699円、豚足、キムチ、にんにくのもやしナムル、骨のスープ、大きなおにぎり、土鍋ご飯、味付けが似ている・席が近いとの声 (2026年8月)、喫煙可が残念との声 (2026年9月)、土曜21時は満席。

cultural_comfort.note: Lively and close-packed; smoking allowed; cards, IC and QR.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; opened July 2026; reviews through September 2026.

kyoto_gate_hotel_lobby_lounge.gf_detail: Ask. Cocktails, wine, whisky and Kyoto craft gin; snacks such as raw chocolate, fries and Kyoto pickles; a clubhouse sandwich; no gluten information (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_gate_hotel_lobby_lounge.vegan_detail: Ask. Drinks and light snacks; no ingredient information (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_gate_hotel_lobby_lounge.hours_raw: Daily 6:30–22:30 per Tabelog; irregular closing days; hours may change (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). Cards, e-money and QR; non-smoking (Tabelog). Counter, sofas and a terrace on the top floor of the hotel, with views of Higashiyama, the Kamo River and Minami-za (2025–2026 reviews). In the former Rissei Elementary School (1928), now Rissei Garden HULIC Kyoto, off Takoyakushi east of Kawaramachi; 3 min walk from Hankyu Kawaramachi Stn (Tabelog; April 2026).
kyoto_gate_hotel_lobby_lounge.notes: [Hotel lounge · Kawaramachi, top-floor views] The lobby lounge and bar on the top floor of THE GATE HOTEL Kyoto Takasegawa, in a converted 1928 school: sink into a sofa or the terrace for wide views over Higashiyama, the Kamo River and Minami-za, with Kyoto craft gin, cocktails, wine or an afternoon coffee and clubhouse sandwich. Quiet by day, reasonable for a hotel. Open from early morning to 22:30.

chef_bio.background: Per the hotel site and reviews: the lobby lounge and bar of THE GATE HOTEL Kyoto Takasegawa by HULIC, on the top floor of a building in the redeveloped former Kyoto City Rissei Elementary School (completed 1928, per an April 2026 reviewer), with a separate hotel restaurant alongside.
chef_bio.specialty: Kyoto craft gin; views of Higashiyama.

anecdotes.text: An April 2026 reviewer on a tour of retro buildings noted the former Rissei Elementary School, completed in 1928, and the lounge's selection of Kyoto craft gin.
An August 2026 visitor sent from the fully booked restaurant to the lounge found it nearly empty and quiet on a Sunday afternoon.
A July 2026 guest stopped after dinner for Yamazaki on the rocks with the night view of Higashiyama.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: バー、中京区蛸薬師通河原町東入備前島町310-2 ゲートホテルKYOTO、阪急四条河原町から294m、毎日 6:30〜22:30、不定休、営業時間は変わることあり、予約可、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、禁煙、景色・夜景がよい。口コミ (2025年11月〜2026年9月、英語): 旧 Rissei 小学校 (1928年) を生かした Rissei Garden HULIC Kyoto のホテル最上階、東山・鴨川・南座の眺め、ソファ、テラス、カウンター、カクテル (Viva La Vida)、京都のクラフトジン、ワイン、ウイスキー (Yamazaki)、生チョコ、フライドポテト、京漬物、クラブハウスサンド、昼は静か、ホテルの値段としては手ごろ。

cultural_comfort.note: Hotel lounge; cards, IC and QR; non-smoking.

existence.note: Tabelog listing and hotel site; reviews through September 2026.

kyoto_kogara_shokudo_yoru_sakaba.gf_detail: Not GF: breaded tonkatsu and karaage (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_kogara_shokudo_yoru_sakaba.vegan_detail: Not vegan: pork cutlet and fried chicken set meals, served with bonito and kombu dashi (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_kogara_shokudo_yoru_sakaba.hours_raw: Lunch daily 11:00–14:30; dinner 17:30–21:30, to 22:00 on Thursday and Saturday (Tabelog); the opening press release gave dinner to 22:30 on Friday, Saturday and holiday eves — hours may change (Tabelog; press release). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). Cashless only — cards, e-money, QR and Apple Pay; no cash (Tabelog). Counter and about two tables; non-smoking; self-service water; order by QR code (Tabelog; December 2025 and March 2026). Down a passage beside an apartment building, near ja!rêve, on Kawaramachi south of Bukkoji; 4 min walk from Hankyu Kawaramachi Stn (Tabelog; December 2025). Opened 24 December 2025 (Tabelog; press release).
kyoto_kogara_shokudo_yoru_sakaba.notes: [Tonkatsu · Kawaramachi-Bukkoji, hidden down a passage] A small new set-meal shop tucked behind an apartment block, serving pink, low-temperature rosé tonkatsu with salt or a pour of dashi instead of sauce, plus crisp karaage with Kujo negi, over a white-and-brown rice blend — from ¥1,380 at lunch, with drinks at night. Cashless only.

chef_bio.background: Per the opening press release: run by 株式会社UEiQ, a restaurant operator whose fire control was honed making chashu for ramen; opened 24 December 2025 as a set-meal shop for locals by day and a tavern by night; the name comes from 小柄 (こがら, compact, small box) and a wish to stay humble. December 2025 reviewers say UEiQ opened several Kyoto restaurants that year.
chef_bio.philosophy: Compact and humble — 小柄 (press release).

anecdotes.text: A December 2025 visitor ran into a manager recognised from another of the operator's restaurants, and preferred the crisp karaage to the tonkatsu.
A February 2026 diner ordered the smallest 150 g Kuro Kirishima Sanroku cutlet and was startled by its size, and by being told to eat it with dashi.
A March 2026 weekday-lunch guest found the place empty after 13:00, ordered by QR code and had the set in about seven minutes.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: とんかつ、下京区河原町通仏光寺下ル富永町354、阪急河原町駅から徒歩4分、昼 毎日 11:00〜14:30、夜 17:30〜21:30 (木・土は22:00まで)、予約可、現金不可 (カード・電子マネー・QR・Apple Pay)、禁煙、カウンター、2025年12月24日開店。プレスリリース: 株式会社UEiQ、ラーメンのチャーシュー作りで培った火入れ、昼は定食屋・夜は酒場、ロゼとんかつ御膳1,380円、からあげ御膳 (5個、九条ねぎだれ) 1,430円、店名は「小柄 (こがら) ＝小箱・コンパクト」と謙虚さから。口コミ (2025年12月〜2026年3月、英語): マンションの奥の通路、赤ワインに漬けて低温で揚げたロゼとんかつ、塩・柚子おろし・かつおと昆布のだしで、Kuro Kirishima Sanroku の豚150g 1,980円・300g 2,550円、合い盛り1,480円、温玉のロゼかつ丼、白米と玄米のブレンド、キャベツ、冷奴、漬物、味噌汁、水はセルフ、QR注文。

cultural_comfort.note: QR ordering; cashless only; self-service water.

existence.note: Tabelog listing and opening press release; reviews through March 2026.

kyoto_gion_manju_shijo.gf_detail: Ask. Rice-flour sweets such as shinko and minazuki, mochi and warabi mochi; no ingredient or gluten information (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_gion_manju_shijo.vegan_detail: Ask. Rice flour, red bean, kinako and sugar sweets look plant-based, but no ingredient information (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_gion_manju_shijo.hours_raw: Daily 10:00–17:30; hours may change (Tabelog). Takeaway only — no seating (Tabelog). Cash only: no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). Seasonal items sell out, e.g. matcha minazuki and matcha shinko (June and September 2026). On Shijo-dori right next to Minami-za, by Keihan Gion-Shijo Stn exit 6 (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_gion_manju_shijo.notes: [Wagashi · Shijo beside Minami-za, takeaway] A long-established sweets shop next to the Minami-za theatre, popular with theatregoers at the interval: chewy cinnamon shinko, summer minazuki in three flavours, kashiwa mochi with miso bean paste and generously dusted warabi mochi, from about ¥190. One June 2026 buyer found the white minazuki a little too sweet. Takeaway only; cash.

chef_bio.background: Per reviews (2025–2026): a traditional wagashi shop next to Minami-za on Shijo-dori; a July 2026 reviewer gives its founding as 1819 (Bunsei 2). Known for shinko and monthly seasonal sweets.

anecdotes.text: A July 2026 mother and daughter dropped in during the interval of a Minami-za performance for shinko at ¥190.
A June 2026 theatregoer found the matcha minazuki sold out and the white one a little too sweet.
A May 2026 regular buys the seasonal sweets on every Kawaramachi visit, and favours the kashiwa mochi with miso bean paste.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 和菓子、東山区四条通大和大路西入ル、京阪祇園四条駅6番出口すぐ、毎日 10:00〜17:30、営業時間は変わることあり、予約不可、カード・電子マネー・QR 不可、イートインなし、テイクアウト。口コミ (2025年10月〜2026年10月、英語): 南座の隣、1819年 (文政2年) 創業との声、しんこ190円 (にっき・白・抹茶)、水無月230円 (白・Hateruma の黒糖・宇治抹茶)、柏餅250円 (味噌あん・こしあん)、笹餅230円、わらび餅、栗蒸し羊羹、抹茶は売り切れのことも、白の水無月は少し甘すぎたとの声 (2026年6月)。

kyoto_gion_manju_shijo.pin_source: Tabelog https://tabelog.com/en/kyoto/A2601/A260301/26003473/ (35.003688, 135.772304) is 1.6 m from kyoto_matsuba_honten, so moved ~6.4 m east along Shijo to 135.772374; the address has no lot number, so loc_precise false; 2026-11-07

kyoto_okeya_kyujiro.gf_detail: Ask. A set omakase of sushi, tempura, shabu-shabu and soba (May 2026); tempura and soba usually contain wheat. Tell the restaurant about allergies when booking (Tabelog).
kyoto_okeya_kyujiro.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a seafood omakase of sushi, tempura and shabu-shabu (May 2026).
kyoto_okeya_kyujiro.hours_raw: Wed–Sat: lunch "Ochakase" afternoon tea 11:30–15:30, dinner 17:00–22:00; closed Sunday to Tuesday (Tabelog). Reservation only, online, with a credit card; cancel at least 48 hours ahead; groups of 5 or more pay in full in advance (Tabelog). Service charge 10% (Tabelog, Japanese text: 「サービス料10％」). Cards incl. UnionPay; no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 12 counter seats (Tabelog). Non-smoking (Tabelog). Hard to find — staff meet guests at the entrance at the booked time (April 2026). Off Nishikiyamachi north of Shijo, 3 min from Kyoto-Kawaramachi and Gion-Shijo (Tabelog).
kyoto_okeya_kyujiro.notes: [Theatrical omakase · Nishikiyamachi, sushi as a stage show] A 12-seat counter where a curtain rises on a two-hour staged omakase — sushi, tempura, shabu-shabu, soba and matcha, with bamboo-leaf carving and lantern light — from a group whose Montreal, Vancouver and Toronto restaurants have Michelin recognition. Lunch is a hands-on matcha and wagashi afternoon tea. English-speaking staff. Wed–Sat, booking online only; 10% service charge.

roles: Founder Matsuda (given name not in the sources), from Mie Prefecture (May 2026 review)
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a sensory dining experience from a chef behind a Michelin one-star restaurant, with a theatre-style omakase dinner and an "Ochakase" afternoon tea. A May 2026 review says the group was founded by Matsuda, from Mie, and opened in Montreal in 2020 (featured in Quebec's first Michelin selection in 2025), Vancouver in 2022 (one Michelin star within a year) and Toronto in 2024 (Michelin-listed in its first year), before Kyoto.
chef_bio.philosophy: Food, sound, aroma and performance combined into one experience (Tabelog).

anecdotes.text: A May 2026 diner describes staff in traditional dress leading guests into a lantern-lit room, then a black curtain rising a minute after sitting down.
A May 2026 host who usually interprets for overseas guests found every staff member spoke English and knew the details.
An October 2026 diner found the food better than expected — and the bill high.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 寿司・日本料理、中京区西木屋町通四条上る紙屋町367、阪急京都河原町駅・京阪祇園四条駅から徒歩約3分、水〜土11:30〜15:30と17:00〜22:00、日月火休み、完全予約制 (オンライン、カード必須、48時間前までのキャンセル、5名以上は前払いとサービス料20%)、サービス料10%、カウンター12席、禁煙、ミシュラン一つ星の店を手がけたシェフ、劇場型のおまかせディナー、昼は「Ochakase」のアフタヌーンティー。口コミ (2026年4月〜10月、英語): 創業者は三重出身の Matsuda、モントリオール (2020年)、バンクーバー (2022年)、トロント (2024年)、寿司、天ぷら、しゃぶしゃぶ、そば、抹茶、sasagiri の実演、和菓子作り、英語が通じる。複数の口コミ (2026年4月・5月) で海外からの客が多いとある。

cultural_comfort.note: Staff speak English (May 2026); book online with a card; arrive on time — staff meet guests at the entrance. Several reviews (April and May 2026) say most guests come from overseas.

existence.note: Tabelog listing and official site; reviews dated through October 2026.

kyoto_okeya_kyujiro.pin_source: Tabelog https://tabelog.com/en/kyoto/A2601/A260201/26044618/ (35.004901, 135.770073), offset 6 m west to clear kyoto_sumibi_kotepan (1.1 m away at the Tabelog point); cross-checked: GSI 京都府京都市中京区紙屋町367番地 (lot) 14m; 2026-11-07

kyoto_kyo_no_sakana_katsugi.gf_detail: Ask. Fish courses with sashimi, grilled fish and ankake dishes (2024–26 reviews); no gluten information.
kyoto_kyo_no_sakana_katsugi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a fish restaurant — sashimi, grilled fish, dashi ankake (2024–26 reviews).
kyoto_kyo_no_sakana_katsugi.hours_raw: Daily 17:00–22:30 (last order food 21:00, drinks 21:30; courses to 21:00); closed irregularly (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; 50% cancellation fee the day before, 100% on the day; call ahead to bring children or pets (Tabelog). Table charge ¥1,100 when ordering à la carte (Tabelog, Japanese text: 「アラカルトの場合：席料1100円」). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 22 seats, mostly private rooms, on the second floor of a building (Tabelog; November 2023; January 2026). Heated tobacco only, in a smoking area; wheelchair accessible (Tabelog). Dogs allowed in private rooms with notice, for a fee (Tabelog; June and July 2024). On Kiyamachi north of Shijo, 2 min from Kyoto-Kawaramachi (Tabelog).
kyoto_kyo_no_sakana_katsugi.notes: [Fish kaiseki · Kiyamachi, private rooms (dogs welcome)] A second-floor fish restaurant on Kiyamachi, named after Kyoto's old fish carriers, serving seasonal sashimi, grilled fish and ankake dishes as courses in private rooms, with Kyoto sake. Well suited to business dinners and groups — and dogs can join in a private room by arrangement. ¥1,100 table charge à la carte.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a Japanese restaurant on Kiyamachi whose name, Katsugi, comes from the fishmongers who once carried live fish into Kyoto; seasonal dishes with fine fish and mainly Kyoto sake, in private rooms; pets welcome with notice.

anecdotes.text: A July 2024 visitor brought a dog to a private room and was grateful for the air conditioning and the help charging a phone.
A March 2024 host chose it for a Muslim friend who does not eat pork, because the menu centres on fish.
A December 2024 family gathering found the dishes excellent but the pacing slow — three and a half hours to dessert.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 日本料理・居酒屋・海鮮、中京区四条木屋町上ル鍋屋町217、阪急河原町駅から徒歩2分、毎日17:00〜22:30 (L.O. 料理21:00、ドリンク21:30)、不定休、予約可、キャンセル料あり、子供やペットは事前に電話で、アラカルトの場合は席料1100円、カード可、22席、個室、加熱式たばこの喫煙所、車椅子可、店名は京都に生きた魚を運んだ人たち (Katsugi) から、旬の魚と京都の日本酒。口コミ (2023年11月〜2026年1月、英語): 刺身、焼き魚、餡かけ、飲み放題付き10,000円のコース、お節、犬と個室で、料理の間隔が長いとの声も。

cultural_comfort.note: Book a course and a private room; tell the restaurant ahead if bringing a dog or children. No English evidence found.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through January 2026.

kyoto_18_premier_bar.gf_detail: Ask. A drinks bar — beer, highballs, cocktails, wine, shochu (2025 reviews); beer contains gluten; no food information.
kyoto_18_premier_bar.vegan_detail: Ask. Drinks only in the sources (2025 reviews).
kyoto_18_premier_bar.hours_raw: 21:00–5:00; closed Tuesday; hours may change (Tabelog; May 2025). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). Cards accepted; no e-money or QR (Tabelog). Smoking allowed (Tabelog). All-you-can-drink pricing differs by gender and for students, per May–June 2025 reviews: men from ¥3,500, women from ¥2,500 (women ¥1,000 for one hour), students ¥2,000 with ID; a two-hour limit on Fridays, weekends and holidays (May 2025). Darts, karaoke rooms and a VIP room with a ¥5,000 charge (May and June 2025). Yaei Building Kiyamachi 3F, north of Shijo, 2 min from Kyoto-Kawaramachi (Tabelog; May 2025).
kyoto_18_premier_bar.notes: [Bar · Kiyamachi, all-you-can-drink until 5 am] A neon-lit third-floor bar off Kiyamachi with graffiti walls, darts, karaoke rooms and a VIP room, built around cheap free-time all-you-can-drink — priced differently for men, women and students — and open until 5:00. Smoking allowed. Closed Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a bar on the third floor of the Yaei Building on Kiyamachi, open late. Reviews in 2025 describe neon and graffiti decor, darts, karaoke rooms and a VIP room.

anecdotes.text: An April 2025 visitor brought friends from abroad here for an after-party following a day of sightseeing.
A June 2025 pair, mindful of the last train, had one drink each under the wall-to-wall graffiti.
A June 2025 visitor returning to Kiyamachi after fifteen years found the street transformed, and ended the night here.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: バー、中京区鍋屋町217 弥栄ビル木屋町 3F、21:00〜翌5:00、火曜休み、予約可、カード可、喫煙可。口コミ (2025年4月〜8月、英語): ネオンとグラフィティの内装、ダーツ、カラオケの部屋、VIP ルーム (チャージ5,000円、オリジナルのシャンパン)、時間無制限の飲み放題は男性3,500円から、女性2,500円から、女性1時間1,000円、学生2,000円、金土日祝は2時間制、ハイボール、カクテル、ワイン、焼酎。

cultural_comfort.note: Ask for the all-you-can-drink plan; smoking allowed; open very late. No English evidence found.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through August 2025.

kyoto_yakiniku_ryu_kawaramachi.gf_detail: Ask. Grilled wagyu with sauces, plus chijimi, kimchi and namul (September–October 2026); no gluten information.
kyoto_yakiniku_ryu_kawaramachi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a wagyu yakiniku restaurant (2026 reviews).
kyoto_yakiniku_ryu_kawaramachi.hours_raw: Daily 16:00–23:00 (last order food 22:00, drinks 22:30); open all year (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; bookings more than 15 minutes late without notice are cancelled (Tabelog). Year-end surcharge of 10% in December and to 5 January (Tabelog, Japanese text: 「※12/4.5.11〜1/5まで年末年始料金として10％頂いてます」). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, Diners) and PayPay; no e-money (Tabelog). 51 seats over two floors (5F and 6F) with sofa seating and a terrace (Tabelog; October 2026). Non-smoking (Tabelog). On Kawaramachi north of Shijo, 2 min from Kyoto-Kawaramachi (Tabelog; September 2026). Opened 9 December 2024 (Tabelog).
kyoto_yakiniku_ryu_kawaramachi.notes: [Wagyu yakiniku · Kawaramachi, tongue and skirt] A two-floor yakiniku above Kawaramachi specialising in A5 black wagyu tongue and skirt, best known for the ¥4,500 "Hakuryu" all-you-can-eat course of some 95 items, from tongue sashimi and yukhoe to kalbi and loin. Open daily from 16:00; 10% surcharge over the New Year period.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a yakiniku restaurant specialising in black wagyu tongue and skirt, opened in December 2024 on the fifth and sixth floors of a Kawaramachi building; a sister shop is in Namba Sennichimae.
chef_bio.specialty: Wagyu tongue and skirt; all-you-can-eat course.

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 diner, driving afterwards, appreciated the ¥500 soft-drink free flow with the Hakuryu course.
An October 2026 visitor named the "revolutionary" skirt the best of the course.
An October 2026 pair arriving late on a rainy night found the floor nearly empty and had most orders within five minutes.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 焼肉・ホルモン・居酒屋、中京区河原町通四条上ル2塩屋町336 志津屋四条河原町ビル 5F・6F、毎日16:00〜23:00 (L.O. 料理22:00、ドリンク22:30)、年中無休、予約可 (15分以上の遅刻は自動キャンセル)、年末年始料金10%、カード・PayPay 可、51席、禁煙、2024年12月9日オープン。口コミ (2026年9月〜11月、英語): A5の黒毛和牛、タンとハラミ、Hakuryu の食べ放題コース4,500円 (約95品)、ソフトドリンク飲み放題+500円、ネギのタン、カルビ、ロース、タン刺し、タンのユッケ、炙り、キムチ、ナムル、チヂミ、コーンバター、わかめスープ、シャーベット。

cultural_comfort.note: The all-you-can-eat course is the easy order; arrive on time — late bookings are cancelled after 15 minutes. No English evidence found.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through November 2026.

kyoto_yakiniku_ryu_kawaramachi.pin_source: Tabelog https://tabelog.com/en/kyoto/A2601/A260201/26042170/ (35.005361, 135.769561); cross-checked: GSI 京都府京都市中京区塩屋町336番地 (lot) 14m; 2026-11-07

kyoto_izakaya_suzume_pontocho.gf_detail: Ask. Home-style izakaya food — oden, dashimaki, sashimi, yakitori with sansho, fried dishes, curry; no gluten information (2012–2025 reviews).
kyoto_izakaya_suzume_pontocho.vegan_detail: Not vegan: oden in dashi, yakitori, sashimi and fried dishes (2012–2025 reviews).
kyoto_izakaya_suzume_pontocho.hours_raw: Monday–Wednesday and Friday–Sunday 16:15–22:00; Thursday 17:00–22:00; open on New Year's Eve (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). Cash only: no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). An appetizer charge of about ¥500, with the bill rounded up (April 2014). 14 seats: 6 at the counter, 2 tables for 4; non-smoking (Tabelog). Down Pontocho's alley 15 north of Shijo, marked only by a red lantern; 5 min walk from Gion-Shijo, Kawaramachi and Sanjo Stns (Tabelog; November 2024). Opened 2 March 1985 (Tabelog).
kyoto_izakaya_suzume_pontocho.notes: [Izakaya · Pontocho alley 15, since 1985] A tiny red-lantern izakaya down one of Pontocho's numbered alleys, run since 1985 and now by the second generation: home-style oden, dashimaki and yakitori with sansho, sake, and above all a chatty host and plenty of Pontocho stories. Opens at 16:15 for early drinks. Cash only; small appetizer charge.

roles: Owners (unnamed): a talkative host and a partner in the kitchen; second generation since July 2022
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: an izakaya opened 2 March 1985; from July 2022 the second-generation proprietress has carried on the business. Reviewers describe a husband-and-wife team, the host chatting and the partner cooking (2012–2018, September 2025), and in November 2024 sister owners full of stories.

anecdotes.text: An April 2014 visitor found the owner alone that day and heard non-stop talk of yamauni tofu, horse racing and sushi — but thought the ¥500 appetizer and rounded-up bill a bit pricey.
A September 2023 guest heard many stories about Pontocho, including advice on why some places turn first-timers away.
A November 2024 party, booked ahead, squeezed in at 20:55 on a full night for a draft beer and the menu of seafood and home cooking.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 居酒屋、中京区先斗町四条上がる15番ろうじ、阪急河原町駅・京阪三条駅・祇園四条駅から徒歩5分、月〜水・金〜日 16:15〜22:00、木 17:00〜22:00、大晦日も営業、予約可、カード・電子マネー・QR 不可、14席 (カウンター6、4人がけテーブル2)、禁煙、1985年3月2日開店、2022年7月から2代目の女将が引き継いで営業再開。口コミ (2012年10月〜2025年9月、英語): 赤ちょうちんだけが目印の路地の店、話好きな主人と料理担当の連れ合い、2024年11月は姉妹の店主とも、壁の短冊のメニュー、おでん、だし巻き、刺身、焼き魚、山椒の赤鶏の焼鳥、yamauni 豆腐、揚げ物、カレー、日本酒、焼酎、生ビール、お通しは500円ほどで会計は切り上げ、やや高いとの声 (2014年4月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Tiny counter bar with chatty hosts; cash only.

existence.note: Tabelog listing (business resumed July 2022); latest review September 2025.

kyoto_izakaya_suzume_pontocho.pin_source: Tabelog https://tabelog.com/en/kyoto/A2601/A260201/26001961/ (35.005751, 135.770930) is 0.5 m from kyoto_pontocho_tabakoya, so moved ~6.4 m east toward Pontocho to 135.771000 (6.8 m from it; kyoto_itameshi_oliva 5.4 m); the address is an alley with no lot number, so loc_precise false; checked against main ad25a35a; 2026-11-07

kyoto_enamiya_saku_no_ma.gf_detail: Not GF: okonomiyaki, omusoba with yakisoba noodles, tonpei-yaki with sauce (2017–2024 reviews).
kyoto_enamiya_saku_no_ma.vegan_detail: Not vegan: egg and pork teppan dishes, corned beef, kabuto miso (2017–2024 reviews).
kyoto_enamiya_saku_no_ma.hours_raw: Monday and Wednesday–Sunday 19:00–5:00, last order 3:00; closed Tuesday; hours may change (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). 16 seats, counter and tables, upstairs in a small alley building; smoking allowed (Tabelog; June 2022). Down alley 13 between Kiyamachi and Pontocho, east off Teruya-koji (Tabelog; April 2018). Website sakunoma.com (Tabelog).
kyoto_enamiya_saku_no_ma.notes: [Teppan bar · alley 13 off Kiyamachi, till 5 a.m.] A snug upstairs bar hidden in a numbered alley between Kiyamachi and Pontocho, where regulars and late-shift locals come for omusoba, tonpei-yaki and tonjiru after midnight, with Shuhari and Kenbishi sake and a homemade ginger sour. A friendly master and a rock soundtrack. Smoking allowed; closed Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a late-night dining bar in alley 13, with a website at sakunoma.com. A March 2019 reviewer writes that the owner is the vocalist of a legendary Kyoto band; an April 2018 reviewer that the president of Matsumoto Brewery worked there part-time as a student. Reviewers describe a warm master and many regulars (2024).

anecdotes.text: An April 2018 reviewer calls it the spot where the president of Matsumoto Brewery once worked part-time as a student — and it pours that brewery's Shuhari.
A March 2019 regular says the owner is the vocalist of a legendary Kyoto band, which shows in the music, and that industry people gather after midnight.
A May 2026 regular of four visits looks forward each year to the homemade ginger sour.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ダイニングバー、中京区木屋町てるや小路東入ル13番路地、月・水〜日 19:00〜翌5:00 (L.O.3:00)、火曜休み、営業時間は変わることあり、予約可、16席、喫煙可、公式サイト sakunoma.com。口コミ (2017年11月〜2026年5月、英語): 木屋町と先斗町の間の13番路地、小さな飲食ビルの2階、オムそば、とん平焼き、卵とかつお節たっぷりのお好み焼き、honmoku-yaki、コンビーフ、板わさ、かぶと味噌、ミックスナッツ、豚汁、粕汁、大きなおにぎり、Matsumoto Shuzo の Shuhari、Kenbishi の燗、自家製のはじかみのジンジャーサワー、ロックのポスター、店主は京都の伝説的なバンドのボーカルとの声 (2019年3月)、Matsumoto Shuzo の社長が学生時代にアルバイトをしていたとの声 (2018年4月)、常連が多い。

cultural_comfort.note: Small regulars' bar; open very late; smoking allowed.

existence.note: Tabelog listing and website; latest review May 2026.

kyoto_siesta_burrito_fuyacho.gf_detail: Not GF: wheat-tortilla burritos and wraps, some freshly fried (2026 reviews).
kyoto_siesta_burrito_fuyacho.vegan_detail: Ask. Burritos are packed with vegetables, beans and rice, and the menu lists every ingredient, but the classic has chicken; no vegan option confirmed (2026 reviews).
kyoto_siesta_burrito_fuyacho.hours_raw: Daily 11:00–21:00, last order 20:50 (Tabelog). Queues at lunch and weekends — 40–50 minutes on a July 2026 holiday — but walk-ins in the evening (July–September 2026). Order and pay first, then sit; takeaway popular; a burrito can be cut in half (July–September 2026). Payment methods not listed on Tabelog. A small shop in an old house off Kawaramachi, on Fuyacho south of Ayanokoji (Tabelog; August 2026). Opened 22 November 2024 (Tabelog).
kyoto_siesta_burrito_fuyacho.notes: [Burritos · Fuyacho off Kawaramachi] A small, upbeat burrito and taco shop in an old house: huge, chewy-tortilla burritos stuffed with vegetables, chicken, beans and rice — the ¥1,100 Classic is the favourite — plus wraps, tacos and a kids taco rice. Order and pay first; expect a queue at lunch. Staff lent ice packs and umbrellas to the summer line.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a taco shop opened 22 November 2024 on Fuyacho. Reviewers in 2026 describe a lively, relaxed staff, a menu listing every ingredient, and many takeaway orders.

anecdotes.text: In July 2026 staff lent a towel-wrapped ice pack to a parent queuing 40–50 minutes in the sun with a two-year-old, and umbrellas to others in line.
An August 2026 diner noticed a pedal-operated hand-washing station.
A September 2026 visitor found the ¥1,100 Classic so good it went down like a drink.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: タコス、下京区麩屋町通綾小路下る俵屋町309-1、京都河原町駅から313m、毎日 11:00〜21:00 (L.O.20:50)、2024年11月22日開店。口コミ (2026年7月〜10月、英語): 古い家の外観でおしゃれな店内、昼と週末は行列 (祝日の昼に40〜50分)、夜は待たずに入れる、先に注文と支払い、テイクアウトが多い、野菜・鶏肉・豆・ご飯たっぷりの大きなブリトー、クラシック1,100円、半分に切ってもらえる、サルサで味変、ラップサンド、タコス、ドリンクやメキシカンポテトのセット、子ども用のタコライス、ビール、材料がすべて書かれたメニュー、並ぶ客に保冷剤や日傘を貸してくれた (2026年7月)、足踏み式の手洗い。

cultural_comfort.note: Order and pay at the counter; ingredients listed on the menu; takeaway.

kyoto_siesta_burrito_fuyacho.pin_source: Tabelog https://tabelog.com/en/kyoto/A2601/A260201/26042185/ (35.002293, 135.765680); cross-checked: GSI 京都府京都市下京区俵屋町309番地 (lot) 25 m; nearest Kyoto record 15.8 m away; checked against main ad25a35a; 2026-11-07

kyoto_thai_kitchen_baramee.gf_detail: Ask. Rice dishes and rice-noodle pad thai, but fish sauce, soy-based seasonings, fried spring rolls and curries; no gluten information (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_thai_kitchen_baramee.vegan_detail: Ask. Coriander salad and adjustable dishes, but fish sauce and shrimp are common; staff changed a dressing and the spice level on request (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_thai_kitchen_baramee.hours_raw: Lunch Tuesday–Sunday 11:30–14:30 (last order 14:00). Dinner: Tuesday, Wednesday, Friday and the day after a holiday 18:00–24:00; Thursday 18:00–23:00; Saturday and the day before a holiday 17:00–24:00; Sunday and holidays 17:00–23:00 (last orders 22:00–23:00). Closed Monday (Tuesday if Monday is a holiday); no lunch 1–3 January (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; groups of five or more are split into tables of four; everyone orders a drink at dinner (Tabelog). 1F of the RINSEN AVENUE building on Kiyamachi; 3 min walk from Hankyu Kawaramachi Stn (Tabelog). Opened 22 June 2018 (Tabelog).
kyoto_thai_kitchen_baramee.notes: [Thai · Kiyamachi north of Shijo] A lively Thai kitchen on Kiyamachi with a Thai chef, per a reviewer: pad thai and gapao lunch sets for ¥1,180 (free large pad thai), and at night tom yum goong, soft-shell crab curry, shrimp spring rolls and Thai hotpot, with courses and all-you-can-drink. Spice can be dialled down — or up. One July 2026 diner found it average. Closed Monday.

roles: Thai chef (unnamed, per a June 2026 review)
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a Thai restaurant, izakaya and dining bar opened 22 June 2018 on Kiyamachi. A June 2026 reviewer credits a Thai chef; reviewers describe friendly staff who adjust spice and dressings on request (2025–2026).

anecdotes.text: A December 2025 diner worried about heat had the gapao rice made without spice and the salad dressing changed.
A January 2026 lunch guest chose the middle of three spice levels for the green curry and found it very hot.
A July 2026 diner found the pad thai just okay — a place for first-timers to Thai food.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: タイ料理・居酒屋・ダイニングバー、中京区下樵木町199-6 RINSEN AVENUEビル1F、阪急河原町駅から徒歩3分、昼 火〜日 11:30〜14:30 (L.O.14:00)、夜 火・水・金・祝翌日 18:00〜24:00、木 18:00〜23:00、土・祝前日 17:00〜24:00、日・祝 17:00〜23:00、月曜休み (祝日の場合は翌火曜)、1月1〜3日は昼なし、予約可、5名以上は4名ずつのテーブル、夜は1人1ドリンク、2018年6月22日開店。口コミ (2025年11月〜2026年10月、英語): タイ人のシェフとの声、屋台のような雰囲気、ステッカーだらけの店内、パッタイのセット1,180円 (大盛り無料)、ガパオライス1,180円、グリーンカレー、カオマンガイ、トムヤムクン、パクチーサラダ、えびの揚げ春巻き250円、生春巻き、ソフトシェルクラブのカレー、タイの鍋、飲み放題付きのコース、辛さを選べる、ナンプラーなどの調味料、グラスビール320円、普通の味との声 (2026年7月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Spice adjustable; one drink each at dinner.

kyoto_thai_kitchen_baramee.pin_source: Tabelog https://tabelog.com/en/kyoto/A2601/A260201/26030959/ (35.006031, 135.770678); cross-checked: GSI 京都府京都市中京区下樵木町199番地 (lot) 18 m; nearest Kyoto record 10.4 m (えなみ家 サクの間, this batch), then kyoto_g_men_kiyamachi 28.4 m; checked against main ad25a35a; 2026-11-07
